paper_title: Top-k Querying of Unknown Values under Order Constraints
statement: partial orders with a bounded-treewidth Hasse diagram, following recent tractability results for the related problem of linear extension counting [30]. Another question is to extend our scheme to request additional values from the crowd, as in [3, 13], and reduce the expected error on the interpolated values or top-k query, relative to a user goal. In such a setting, how should we choose which values to retrieve, and could we update incrementally the results of interpolation when we receive new exact-value constraints? Finally, it would be interesting to study whether our results generalize to different prior distributions on the polytope.
